podcast.title: Architects of Art Podcast Co-Host
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot is a co-host of the new podcast "Architects of Art," where he and Director X interview music video storytellers to delve into their creative journeys, influences, and the processes behind their iconic works. "We have Tadges Christelot and Director X. And we want to give you a bit of an introduction to what this new podcast is all about."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Brampton, Ontario Origins
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot is from Brampton, Ontario, and is recognized for his journey from there to creating impactful art on a global scale. "And there were two kids from Brampton, Ontario that went out to make art that broke out to the world."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Co-host of Art Context Podcast
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot co-hosts the new podcast "Art Context: The Architects of Art." This show aims to highlight the creative artists behind music videos, sharing their stories, influences, and processes. "We have Tadges Christelot and Director X."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: Digital Debris Part 1: B-Sides and Bonus Tracks

podcast.title: Extensive Music Video Directing Career
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot has directed music videos for a wide array of prominent artists including Alicia Keys, Puff Daddy, Sisqo, Destiny's Child, Drake, Justin Bieber, 2 Chainz, Rosalía, Iggy Azalea, Sean Paul, Beenie Man, Ariana Grande, and John Mayer, describing his career as a "crazy journey." "I've directed videos for Alicia Keys, Puff Daddy, Cisco, Destiny's Child, Drake, Justin Bieber, Two Chains, Rosalie, Igeez, Shampo, Beanie Man, Ariana Grande. John Mayer, the list goes on. This has literally been a crazy journey."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Fella Production Company Breakout
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot, alongside Director X, established their production company, Fella, achieving a breakthrough with the music video for DJ Khaled, Drake, and Justin Bieber's "Popstar." "We broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled, Drake and Bieber called Popstar."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Music Video Director and Producer
podcast.body: Tadges Christelot is involved in the music video world and is part of the production company Fella, which gained recognition with the "Topstar" music video. He views the podcast as another medium for storytelling, focusing on the creative journey of filmmakers. "We broke our production company, Fella, with this music video for DJ Khaled Drake and Bieber called Topstar. So it's been a crazy journey."
